en.text: Types of Goods

zh.text: 物品和服務的種類

en.text: A department store reduced the price of its television sets but there was still unsold stock. These television sets are

zh.text: 某百貨公司將店內的電視機減價，但仍未能沽清存貨。這些電視機是

en.text: Free goods because the quantity supplied is greater than the quantity demanded.

zh.text: 免費物品，因為供應量大於需求量。

en.text: Consumer goods because they are sold at a department store.

zh.text: 消費品，因為在百貨公司內出售。

en.text: Capital goods because they are man-made.

zh.text: 資本物品，因為是人造的。

en.text: Economic goods because people have to pay a price for them.

zh.text: 經濟物品，因為人們須付出代價以獲取。

en.text: HKCEE 1996 Paper 2 Q2

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1996 卷二 第 2 題

en.text: The television broadcast of European football matches is

zh.text: 下列哪項有關歐洲足球賽事的電視廣播的陳述是正確的？

en.text: a public good if citizens can enjoy the broadcast of matches in public areas like restaurants and Karaoke lounges.

zh.text: 若市民可在公眾場所如餐廳和卡拉 OK 欣賞賽事廣播，這些賽事的電視廣播便是共用品。

en.text: a private good if a local television broadcasting company has purchased the exclusive right to broadcast in Hong Kong.

zh.text: 若某本地電視台購買了在本港的獨家播映權，這些賽事的電視廣播便是私用品。

en.text: a free good because there is no cost in serving an additional viewer.

zh.text: 這些賽事的電視廣播是免費物品，因爲服務額外一位觀眾是沒有成本的。

en.text: a producer good if the broadcast is used to teach the children in a football training school.

zh.text: 若足球訓練學校播放這些比賽作教導兒童之用，這些賽事的電視廣播便是生產者物品。

en.text: HKDSE 2013 Paper 1 Q6

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2013 卷一 第 6 題

en.text: Which of the following statements about the exhibits in the Louvre Museum is correct?

zh.text: 下列哪項有關羅浮宮博物館展品的陳述是正確的？

en.text: They are public goods because the Louvre Museum is open to the public.

zh.text: 它們是共用品，因為羅浮宮博物館向公眾開放。

en.text: They are capital because they are man-made resources used in production.

zh.text: 它們是資本，因為它們是用於生產的人造資源。

en.text: They are consumer goods because more of them are preferred.

zh.text: 它們是消費物品，因為人們渴望更多的展品。

en.text: They are economic goods because they satisfy human wants.

zh.text: 它們是經濟物品，因為它們滿足人類的需要。

en.text: HKDSE 2018 Paper 1 Q5

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2018 卷一 第 5 題

en.text: The Government purchased the broadcasting rights of the Tokyo 2020 Olympic Games. This enabled all Hong Kong people to watch the events for free. The Olympic Games broadcast is a ______________ because ______________.

zh.text: 政府購入了 2020 東京奧運的轉播權，令全港市民能免費觀賞各項賽事。該奧運廣播屬 _____________，因為 _____________。

en.text: public good ... the Government paid for the broadcasting rights

zh.text: 共用品 …… 政府支付了轉播權費用

en.text: private good ... one individual’s consumption reduces its amount available to others

zh.text: 私用品 …… 某一個人的消費會令其他人可享用的數量減少

en.text: free good ... more is not preferred

zh.text: 免費物品 …… 人們並不偏好更多該物品

en.text: consumer good ... it can directly satisfy human wants

zh.text: 消費者物品 …… 它能直接滿足人們的欲望

en.text: HKDSE 2022 Paper 1 Q4

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2022 卷一 第 4 題

en.text: Which of the following statements about the classification of goods is correct?

zh.text: 下列哪項有關物品分類的陳述是正確的？

en.text: Musical instruments used by street performers are public goods because the music performed with these instruments can be enjoyed concurrently by many people.

zh.text: 街頭藝人所用的樂器是共用品，因為用這些樂器演奏的音樂可被多人同時享用。

en.text: Textbooks are private goods because the marginal cost of producing an additional unit of textbooks is positive.

zh.text: 課本是私用品，因為生產多一個單位的課本的邊際成本是正數。

en.text: Artworks exhibited in the Hong Kong Palace Museum (香港故宫文化博物馆) are consumer goods because costs are involved in their production.

zh.text: 香港故宮文化博物館展出的藝術品是消費者物品，因為它們的生產涉及成本。

en.text: Popular free online videos for learning English are economic goods because their quantities are not enough to satisfy human wants.

zh.text: 受歡迎的免費網上英語學習影片是經濟物品，因為它們的數量不足夠滿足人們的慾望。

en.text: HKDSE 2023 Paper 1 Q5

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2023 卷一 第 5 題

en.text: Which of the following statements about seawater is correct?

zh.text: 下列哪項關於海水的陳述是正確的？

en.text: Seawater is a capital good when fishermen use it to keep their catches alive.

zh.text: 當漁民用海水保持漁獲鮮活時，海水是資本物品。

en.text: Seawater is a public good as the government provides it to the public for flushing the toilets.

zh.text: 因為政府提供海水予公眾作沖刷之用，所以海水是共用品。

en.text: Seawater is a free good as people can obtain seawater free of charge.

zh.text: 因為人們可以免費獲得海水，所以海水是免費物品。

en.text: Seawater is an inferior good as no one drinks seawater.

zh.text: 因為沒有人飲用海水，所以海水是劣等物品。

en.text: HKDSE 2024 Paper 1 Q3

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2024 卷一 第 3 題

en.text: Trees in a natural rainforest are _____.

zh.text: 天然雨林裏的樹木是 _____。

en.text: economic goods if people are willing to spend money to preserve the trees

zh.text: 經濟物品，假如人們願意花費金錢保育該些樹木

en.text: free goods because they are natural resources which involve no production costs

zh.text: 免費物品，因為它們是不涉及生產成本的天然資源

en.text: land in Economics because they are geographically immobile

zh.text: 經濟學中的土地，因為它們沒有地域流動性

en.text: public goods if the rainforest is managed by the government

zh.text: 共用品，假如該雨林是由政府管理

en.text: HKDSE 2025 Paper 1 Q3

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2025 卷一 第 3 題
